gloss: heaven and earth; the world; top and bottom

definitions.gloss: heaven and earth; the world; a realm
definitions.explanation: The sky and the earth, and by extension the whole world or a world of one's own. Somewhat literary; common in set phrases.
The top and bottom of a package, a page or a picture. Used in packing and printing.

examples.english: There is a world of difference.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あら}た→新た：01697_arata⟧な{天地|てんち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めて→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{渡|わた}った→渡る：02441_wataru⟧。
examples.english: He went abroad in search of a new world.

examples.japanese: {天地|てんち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひっくり{返|かえ}って→ひっくり返る：10544_hikkurikaeru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}を{破|やぶ}らない→約束を破る：20639_yakusokuwoyaburu⟧だろう。
examples.english: He would not break his promise even if the world turned upside down.
I hung the picture upside down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{天地|てんち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わかるよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{矢印|やじるし}→矢印：13669_yajirushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧おこう。
examples.english: When you send a parcel, draw an arrow so the top and bottom of the box are clear.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS (sense 1):
- {天地|てんち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: a world of difference
- {新天地|しんてんち}: a new world, a fresh start
- {天地|てんち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひっくり{返|かえ}る→ひっくり返る：10544_hikkurikaeru⟧: the world turns upside down
- {天地創造|てんちそうぞう}: the Creation

USAGE (sense 2):
{天地|てんち}{無用|むよう} printed on boxes means "do not turn upside down" (this side up), not "top and bottom unnecessary", a common misreading.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧: the world, the everyday word
- ⟦{上下|じょうげ}→上下：04282_jouge⟧: up and down, the plain word for orientation
